notes: Qcadoo's ScheduleState has DRAFT, APPROVED and REJECTED. DRAFT may change to APPROVED or REJECTED; APPROVED may additionally still change to REJECTED (ScheduleState.java:16-23); REJECTED is terminal. URS-W3-005 AC-3 narrows the target to exactly {Draft → Approved, Draft → Rejected}: the Approved → Rejected case is flagged `new_behaviour`, with `expected` the legacy verdict and `expected_target` the Rheinwerk narrowing (docs/design/W3-finite-capacity.md, decision D-W3-2-A).

cases.description: DRAFT → APPROVED: the plan becomes the operative line sequence
DRAFT → REJECTED: the plan is discarded without operative effect
APPROVED → DRAFT is refused — an approved plan is not re-opened
REJECTED → APPROVED is refused — REJECTED is terminal
REJECTED → DRAFT is refused; a new Draft schedule is created instead
a no-op transition is not a state change
an already approved plan cannot be approved again
legacy APPROVED → REJECTED (ScheduleState.java:16-23) is refused by the target: URS-W3-005 AC-3 allows Draft as the only source state
a state outside ScheduleState is refused
a schedule without a state yet is a DRAFT and may be approved
